parsed.why: No criminalisation, self-ID in force, working equal-treatment and hate-crime machinery; but birth-sex prison placement, an unresolved airport-screening complaint, and sauna exclusion guidelines are documented state/operator friction, with political backsliding signals.

No trans criminalisation or documented police targeting, but zero recognition, no protection naming gender identity, general stigmatisation, and thin sourcing — no documented acceptance either, so openness stays mid-range rather than reassuring.

Trans women held in male dormitories with mandatory head-shaving, local cross-dressing bans, patterned transfemicide with weak national recourse — tier-1/tier-2 exposures — partly offset by local SOGI ordinances and slurs statutes.

Court victories (toilet ban struck 2025, surgery bar removed) and functioning relief mitigate, but no anti-discrimination or hate-crime law, documented border abuse of a trans traveller, reported toilet violence, and a rejected partnership bill weigh down.

Sodomy sections unrepealed but unenforced and sexuality, not trans, law; impersonation offence repealed, embedded third-gender tradition with chiefly titles, gender-identity sentencing provision, conversion-therapy ban, and first Pride — tolerant society over a latent statute.
